data.name: Wald
data.long_meaning: The name Wald is derived from the Old German word 'waldaz' meaning 'rule' or 'power'. In Middle English, it was used as a surname for someone who lived in or near a forest. In the context of Christianity, the name Wald can be seen as a reminder of God's protection and rule over our lives.
